stats.text:
You can summon a nature spirit that assumes an animal form to aid you. As a {ref:glossary/magic} action, you can expend a spell slot or a use of Wild Shape to cast the *{ref:spell/find-familiar}* spell without Material components.

When you cast the spell in this way, the familiar is Fey and disappears when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.
